Pearson on UF Jacksonville 'Current Fellows' page through 2025-12-13 (absent 2026-03-14); Cortez listed PGY-1 on UB general surgery roster 2025-09-02 and UB neurosurgery affiliation on a paper received 2025-12. Saint Luke's page captures (2025-03..2025-12) and all Common Crawl crawls have no residents section; Wayback audit of saintlukeskc.org/education and /news 2025-01..2026-09 found no neurosurgery resident news. PubMed affiliation mining (UMKC/Kansas City neurosurgery 2025-26) found no other trainee.
